rules.statement: Verification must be derived from this specification and REF-001/REF-002, not from generated RTL or internal RTL names/structure.

rules.condition: For every supported AHB transfer accepted by the IP
rules.statement: The bridge must convert every accepted supported AHB transfer to AXI4 without loss, duplication or data alteration.
AHB address/control must be sampled only when HSEL=1, HREADY=1 and HTRANS is NONSEQ or SEQ.
IDLE or BUSY transfers must not issue AXI requests.
Each accepted AHB read must issue exactly one AXI single-beat AR transaction.
No read request may be issued before its AHB address is accepted.

rules.condition: AHB SINGLE, undefined-length INCR transfers, and every read beat
rules.statement: AHB SINGLE and undefined-length INCR transfers and every read beat must map to AXI single-beat transactions.

rules.condition: Legal bufferable Normal Write-back fixed write burst of 4, 8 or 16 beats, all data beats captured and burst-scoped AXI address attributes constant
rules.statement: Such a write burst may map to a matching AXI burst only after all data beats are captured and burst-scoped attributes are constant.

rules.condition: Burst aggregation conditions are not met
rules.statement: Otherwise the bridge must issue ordered AXI single-beat writes.
Non-bufferable writes must use single-beat AXI transactions.
AXI WDATA/WSTRB must preserve each AHB HWDATA/HWSTRB beat.
WLAST must identify the final beat of each AXI write transaction.
AHB responses must remain in transfer order.

rules.condition: Aggregated or multi-single Normal Write-back bufferable burst
rules.statement: All B statuses must be combined and any error reported on the terminal AHB beat.

rules.condition: Earlier beats of such a burst once safely buffered
rules.statement: Earlier beats may receive OKAY once safely buffered.
Device memory transfers must not be merged or have their size changed.
Device-E writes must use ordered AXI single-beat transactions and wait for each final-destination BRESP before the AHB response.
No early AHB write response is allowed without a visibility guarantee.

rules.condition: AHB fixed write burst terminated early
rules.statement: An early-terminated fixed write burst must never produce an incomplete AXI burst.
Captured but unissued accepted write beats must be emitted as ordered AXI single-beat transactions without reissuing beats already sent.
The terminal AHB response must be held until all corresponding B responses arrive, and any non-OKAY status reported on it.
No AXI burst may cross a 4 KiB boundary.
The bridge must preserve beat order and aggregate all sub-burst responses onto the final AHB beat.
The single top module m_ahb2axi_top must expose exactly the fixed clock, reset, AHB and AXI ports listed in §6.2.
AHB/AXI USER sideband and zero-width optional ports must not be present.
AHB and AXI interfaces must use the same rising-edge clock input i_clk_core.
No second clock port or clock-domain crossing is permitted.
The bridge must expose one active-low reset input i_rst_n_core and use it directly without an internal reset synchronizer.
The SoC reset source must synchronize deassertion to i_clk_core before the reset reaches the IP.
Reset must clear all bridge/FIFO valid state.
No pre-reset response may be returned after reset release.
AXI OKAY must map to AHB OKAY.

rules.condition: AXI response is SLVERR, DECERR or unexpected EXOKAY
rules.statement: These must map to the AHB two-cycle ERROR response.

rules.condition: HMASTLOCK, HPROT[6]=1, reserved/unsupported HPROT, unsupported HSIZE or misaligned transfer
rules.statement: Such transfers must return two-cycle AHB ERROR.
No AXI request must be issued for the rejected transfer.
Read and write ID-count parameters must be in the range 1..8.
Each direction must rotate IDs through 0..count-1.
ID rotation must not imply multiple outstanding requests.

rules.condition: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed write bursts while buffer capacity is available
rules.statement: The bridge may accept one AHB beat per i_clk_core cycle.
Terminal completion must wait for all required BRESPs.

rules.condition: Single read or single-beat write, synchronous queue has space and AXI READY remains high
rules.statement: AR/AW handshake must occur within 6 i_clk_core cycles of accepted AHB address.
The AW timing target starts after the full burst or its early termination has been captured.
The bridge must not guarantee a bound for full completion, AXI response latency, or traffic under external stalls.
RTL must follow REF-003; the single top module contains only structural instances and each module is in a same-named file.
The IP must have no software-visible CSR interface; all configuration is static at elaboration.
